Subject: Take-home: Frontend Engineer (Senior) — prompt, deadline, and reviewer schedule

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for your time on the interview loop. As discussed, attached is our take-home prompt for the Senior Frontend Engineer role. A few quick notes: 

- Estimated effort: 3–5 hours (we don't expect a full production app).
- Deadline: May 6, 2026 by 11:59 PM PT. If you need an extension, let me know — we can be flexible.
- Submission: Reply to this thread with a link or a ZIP attachment.
- Reviewers: Mina Haddad and Karthik Iyer will be the primary reviewers; we plan a short debrief after submissions.

Attachment: redwood_frontend_takehome.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

If anything in the prompt is unclear, ask here and we’ll clarify. Good luck — looking forward to seeing what you build.

Best,
Monica Patel

Great question — thanks for checking. Short answer: working implementation first; tests are welcome but not required. If you have time for a couple of unit tests (Jest + RTL) that’s a nice-to-have.

We don't require a specific bundler; a small CRA/Vite project or a single static HTML with JS is fine. To make it easier, here's a starter template and a short README: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-takehome-template (contains a minimal Vite template and instructions).

We’ve blocked a 45-min internal review/debrief on May 8, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT to give reviewers time after the deadline. Reviewers: Mina Haddad (frontend lead) and Karthik Iyer (hiring manager). If the deadline shifts we’ll adjust the debrief accordingly.

Let me know if you prefer an alternate submission method (GitHub link vs ZIP).

Thanks,
Monica

--
Attachment: redwood_starter_template.zip (link in Drive)

Thanks,
Karthik
